title: COSMOVERSE: Hybrid Cosmological Modeling, Uncertainty Marginalization & Calibrated Inference Protocol
description: Reproducible three-level cosmological inference protocol connecting TUNeS temporal U-Net emulation, BCEmu baryonic feedback marginalization, Stage-IV observational forward modeling (masks, selection, galaxy bias, RSD multipoles P0/P2/P4), Simulation-Based Inference calibrated via SBC/TARP, leakage-free data partitioning on CAMELS Generation 2 (1,192 simulations), and Stage 5 differentiable field-level inference with preconditioned MCLMC.
